# js-yaml 5.5.0

Unmodified, self-contained ESM build from the official [js-yaml npm package](https://registry.npmjs.org/js-yaml/-/js-yaml-5.5.0.tgz), distributed under the included MIT [LICENSE](LICENSE). Upstream: https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/tree/5.5.0.

Source file: `dist/browser/js-yaml.esm.min.mjs`. Bundled here so marketplace and local installations can parse skill YAML frontmatter without an npm install or runtime download. The upstream source-map reference is retained; the optional source map is not shipped.

Verified tarball SHA-512 (base64):

```text
paNr4LFIFPjeeSmwNYdrb8FafLLG/Cr2Af3GjbsHJ5CxIjH4r0c2emlmRdAtpPAieP1gRVzk6buBbVP5gBMGAg==
```

To update, verify the official package integrity, replace the ESM build and license together, and run the skill-version, packaging, and installation tests. No upstream code is modified.
